description: Generated sound effects for local commerce interactions; not location recordings.

select.prompt: Close dry foley: one gentle plastic push button click from a Japanese drink vending machine, then a tiny soft electronic confirmation chirp. Quiet tactile detail, no speech, no music, no ambience.
select.processing: 5 ms attack and 25 ms release fades; transient compression 8:1; loudness normalization.

dispense.prompt: Close isolated foley of a modern Japanese beverage vending machine dispensing one bottle: a small relay click, soft motor mechanism, then one muted hollow clunk as the bottle settles into the padded collection tray. No coins, no voices, no music.
dispense.processing: 5 ms attack and 25 ms release fades; transient compression 5:1; loudness normalization.

bottle-open.prompt: Isolated intimate foley of slowly twisting open a plastic tea bottle: fine cap ridges turning, tamper seal cracking softly and a tiny release of air. Gentle, dry close recording. No pouring, no speech, no music.
bottle-open.processing: 5 ms attack and 25 ms release fades; transient compression 8:1; loudness normalization.

can-open.prompt: Isolated close foley of opening a small Japanese canned coffee: pull tab metal tick, short restrained seal snap and a faint hiss. Natural quiet handling, not a loud soda spray. No speech, no music.
can-open.processing: 5 ms attack and 25 ms release fades; transient compression 5:1; loudness normalization.

sip.prompt: One small quiet sip from a bottle, intimate natural dry foley, very subtle liquid movement and soft swallowing. Comfortable and understated, no exaggerated mouth sounds, no voice, no music.
sip.processing: 5 ms attack and 25 ms release fades; transient compression 5:1; loudness normalization.

crunch.prompt: One small bite of a thin toasted rice cracker, a delicate dry crispy crackle, gentle intimate food foley. No chewing loop, no speech, no music.
crunch.processing: 5 ms attack and 25 ms release fades; transient compression 5:1; loudness normalization.

paper.prompt: A small paper snack sleeve gently rustles as it is picked up from a counter. One soft dry paper handling motion, close natural foley, no voice, no music.
paper.processing: 5 ms attack and 25 ms release fades; transient compression 5:1; loudness normalization.

vending-hum.prompt: Seamless quiet refrigerator compressor tone of a modern outdoor drink vending machine heard very close: soft low electrical hum with barely audible fan airflow, smooth stable neutral bed, no events, no speech, no music.
vending-hum.processing: 200 ms equal-power overlap, duration restored with slight resampling, 5 ms edge fades, static gain.

shop-grill.prompt: Seamless subtle ambience behind a small Japanese grilled dango counter: gentle charcoal heat, delicate intermittent food sizzling and one distant faint utensil touch. Calm intimate open-air shop, no voices, no music, no loud frying.
shop-grill.processing: 200 ms equal-power overlap, duration restored with slight resampling, 5 ms edge fades, static gain.
